title: The Latest Crier for Nov 07, 2026

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Meals from the Heartland with SSS

SSS is sponsoring , Meals from the Heartland , which is a non-profit organization from Des Moines that packs & sends meals to folks all over the world! Our service project will take place in the Central College field house on the West end of the indoor track on Thursday, November 12, 2026 . Sign up to pack meals or you can also be a table leader that helps fill the buckets. This is a fun event!!! 😊 
Shift 1 : 9:30-10:45 am - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Shift 2 : 11:00 am -12:15 pm - 60 people packing meals plus 5 table leaders 

Thank you!!

Fun Service Opportunities! Green Pod Hours!

Mark your calendar for some volunteer opportunties that count for green pod hours! It will be a great time in community & making a difference in the world. Join us as we serve 11/9 from 5 to 6:30 pm at the Pella Food Shelf. Use the link below to reserve your spot: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1q2jhNfSLPQ4DDH2Xr2C28F7Nq11HH8UNohPgIi7S1_4/edit?usp=sharing

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 11/8/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Fellowship of Christian Athletes

NEXT WEEK: 
Join us for FCA next Tuesday, 11/10 , in the BMW rooms at 8 PM as some of our student leaders guide us through a message. Hope to see you there! 

DUDE'S & GIRL'S NIGHTS: 

Dude's Night : Mark your calendars for November 15 from 4–6 PM! Join other guys at The Loft (929 Opportunity Lane) for an evening of fellowship, tasty food, and a hot dog eating contest. Use the following link to find the QR code to sign up: FCA Dude's Night Sign-Up Flyer 

Girl's Night : More details coming soon, but plan for November 15 around 7 PM at Sweet Henry's! 

- FCA Leadership Team

Personal Statement Workshop: November 10 @ 11 am

On Tuesday, 11/10, at 11 am in Maytag's Van Emmerik Studio, Jeremy Burke will lead students through a Personal Statement Workshop . This workshop will focus on the health professions, but any student preparing a personal statement might benefit. Students in attendance with experience working on a statement will be asked to share their tips & advice, too. Please join us!

Line Dance Night

We are excited to announce that Jara Johnson is partnering with CAB for Line Dance Night! Come to the Graham Conference Center on Sat. Nov. 7th from 7-10pm for a fun evening of line dancing! Jara will teach lessons from 7-8:30pm and open dance will be held from 8:30-10pm. See you there!
